'''The Hutt's Last Laugh''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] that was located in the [[Blinders district]] of the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Sahl-Evin]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Jenenma]]. The [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Orth Maag]] worked in the Last Laugh as a [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]] and the majority of the establishment's patrons were [[Duros/Legends|Duros]]. At some point during [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] history, a group of agents visited The Hutt's Last Laugh while they were tracking down a stolen [[Starship/Legends|starship]] that had been taken to the Blinders district. The [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] [[Tarkil Hroka]] spilt his drink on one of the agents and he attempted to engage in a fight with the individual.
